title: Darius' Amethyst Geode Panorama
description: A simple panorama of the inside of an amethyst geode overlooking a lush cave
body:
A simple panorama of the inside of an amethyst geode overlooking a lush cave. That's really it. I might update in the forseeable future in case I find any other cool geode spots.
